Custom layers for a project that does not use a named architecture.

| Key | Type | Default | Effect | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | — | Implemented | Layer name; becomes the project name. |
| `type` | string | — | Implemented | Project type for the layer. |
| `references` | string[] | — | Implemented | Other layers this layer references. |
| `entities` | entity[] | — | Implemented | Entities assigned to this layer. |
| `services` | string[] | — | Implemented | Services assigned to this layer. |
| `endpoints` | endpoint[] | — | Implemented | Endpoints assigned to this layer. |
